data.name: Terminal Error
data.detailed_description:
"A good soldier always follows orders..."

Thrust into the macabre depths of Site 41, you play as a disoriented soldier caught in an emergency of seismic proportions. Navigate disturbing environments, unravel cryptic puzzles and uncover grotesque truths in this chilling, thrilling reinvention of the point-and-click horror genre.

TERMINAL ERROR unfolds within the bleak and oppressive tunnels of Site 41, a secretive underground facility harbouring classified, experimental technologies. Constructed by the Island Armed Forces (IAF), an advanced military power, the compound was meant to be a fortress of cutting edge power. But this perfect machine conceals some dark secrets…

The story begins when a disoriented soldier awakens alone in a suspiciously desolate guardhouse. Contacting a mysterious commander through the crackling radio, the newfound allies investigate the cause of the facility-wide shutdown in hopes of containing the source of the disaster. Yet, what they uncover is far more horrifying and deadly. Descend into a nightmarish rabbit hole of hidden horrors and dangerous secrets lurking beneath the surface...

Interact and Experience: Unravel unsettling mysterious through our revamped point-and-click mechanics, now with a heightened sense of space.

Mess around with strange devices...

Pick up items...

Fix up broken parts...

Solve challenging puzzles...

Think out of the box...

And learn more about the world along the way...

Explore and Discover: Suspiciously abandoned and packed with secrets, learn about the lore of this strange world as you roam the eerie corridors of Site 41.

Wander through an oppressively imposing military compound...

Creep past bleak office spaces...

And encounter the infection...

Play with Tools: Armed with your Cybernetic Compatibility System (CCS), access a variety of tools to aid you in your journey. Use your trusty torchlight to reveal what's hidden in the dark

With dangers around every corner, heal up with our fresh take on the traditional healing experience

Stun and run from enemies as you explore... The bullets might not kill monsters, but at least it slow them down. If you're lucky, maybe you could slip away in time...

Escape Monsters: Encounter grotesque monsters and explore haunting spaces plastered with flesh, blood and all forms of warped monstrosities as you learn more about the cryptic truth of the facility.

Don't get too close to the monsters though... They can easily grab you, entering into an interesting 'Struggling Minigame' sequence to escape the grasps of these creatures

And of course... Be careful of larger enemies,..

Stop the Infection: Confront grotesque growths at every corner and find a way to put an end to it once and for all

data.short_description: Play as a disoriented soldier in this surreal reimagining of point-and-click horror. Set in the suffocating underground chambers Site 41, discover macabre truths, evade ghoulish monsters and delve deeper into the heart of this twisted nightmare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 2.8 GHz / AMD FX-6300, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with (4GB VRAM) | NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4GB VRAM )
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 | AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with (4GB VRAM) | NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4GB VRAM )
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

content_descriptors.notes: Flesh and blood in the form of dismembered limbs and blood-covered rooms are to be expected. Mild violence in the form of enemy attacks and injury will also be present
